title: fix(pm): label-write --handoff hands the PASS reader a git reader and the base ref
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x8Be2AAcUBhodBsvnWLd3Xs)_
Fixes #36537
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感;席位在合入主干后把受管 PR 交给维护者时,已由重生成说明续管的审核记录不再被误拒。
- 为什么做:车队交接工具的缺陷——交接时读不到合法的重生成续管记录,席位只能多请一轮审核。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是交接被拒(与今天相同),不会把没审过的改动交给维护者;可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

`scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --handoff` (and its `--dry-run` per-round reading) now hands the queue guard's PASS reader the two things its `regenCarry` needs to judge a PASS carried from an older head by a `Regen-provenance:` line:

- `runGit` — `handoffGitReader(repo)`: this checkout's git (`checkoutGit`: argv plus optional stdin, stdout back, throws on any failure), the shape `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` passes. It is null when the pull's repository is not this checkout's `origin`, as `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr` hands none outside its own checkout; the guard's reader then reads the carry as a gap (exit 3), never as clean.
- `baseRef` — the pull's own `base.sha` from the same pull read, null when it is not a full sha.

The injectable seam is `handoffDeps.gitReader` (default `handoffGitReader`); the self-test's `driveOffline` defaults it to "no reader", so the suite stays offline. No regen-carry logic is re-spelled here: `record-recognisers.mjs` decides, and its pins (no reader is unreadable, no base ref is unreadable, an unreachable tree is unreadable) are untouched.

## Why

The card: the hand-off built its `pair` without `runGit` or `baseRef`, so every carried PASS read "this run holds no git reader" and a valid record refused the hand-off (measured on PR #36509).

**Which base ref, measured.** Real trees of PR #36509 (old head `4342cf009`, merge-of-main head `bf71994326`, second parent `0b2118f4`), through the guard's own `unexplainedPathsBetween` / `regenCarry` against this checkout:

| base handed | unexplained paths | `regenCarry` |
|---|---|---|
| `pull.base.sha` = `0b2118f4` (the merged main) | 0 | `carried`, record 7083451259 |
| a base older than the merge (`e4e3bcfe`, what a stale `origin/main` would hold) | 14 (main's own files read as hand edits) | `refused` |
| `origin/main` in this shallow checkout | git throws | `unreadable` |
| none (before this change) | n/a | `unreadable`, "holds no git reader" |

`base.sha` is an immutable commit from the same pull read, and the base `--pr` and the guard's `pull_request` leg hand the same reader. A remote-tracking ref is shared by every worktree and may be stale, and a stale base turns main's carry-over into "hand edits". If the checkout lacks that commit, `merge-base` throws and the guard reads it as unreadable with its own fetch hint, so it is never carried.

## Tests

`node scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --self-test` at head `4c0570e0`: `✓ label-write self-test: 407 cases pass across 19 batteries` (was 398). The `--handoff` battery gains nine cases and its pin goes 59 → 68:

1. a PASS on an older head carried by `Regen-provenance:`, fake git clean (main brought `AGENTS.md`, the pull touched nothing hand-written) ⇒ records ✓, handed off, exit 0; plus a check that the reader's `merge-base` got `base.sha`;
2. the same chain with the pull's own hand-written path ⇒ no same-head PASS, refused, exit 2, zero sends;
3. a git reader that throws ⇒ PREREQUISITE, exit 3, zero sends, with the guard's fetch hint;
4. no reader ⇒ the guard's "holds no git reader" gap, exit 3; no base sha ⇒ the "base ref" gap, exit 3;
5. `--dry-run` reads the carried PASS through the same reader (records ✓, exit 7, nothing sent);
6. `handoffGitReader` origin matching (spelling and case, another repository gives null, an unreadable remote gives null), and the real `checkoutGit` hands git its stdin (`check-attr --stdin` answers `os-regen` for a literal `.gitattributes` row).

<details><summary>Red before the fix, and three ablations after it</summary>

Before the implementation (tests in place, fix absent): `✗ label-write self-test: 7 of 406 case(s) failed`. Case 1 read `got [3,0,false,false], want [0,1,true,true]` with `② PREREQUISITE NOT MET — PR #7's Regen-provenance: chain — this run holds no git reader`.

After committing the fix, each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (the anchor hit on disk, restored blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
- `runGit` changed to `runGit: null` in the pair ⇒ 6 of 407 failed;
- `baseRef` changed to `'origin/main'` ⇒ 2 of 407 failed (the base-sha check and the no-base control);
- `input` removed from the `checkoutGit` spawn ⇒ 1 of 407 failed (the stdin case).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The changes are in one file: `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`. The guard instruments were read but not edited.
- On a sibling-repository pull (the run's checkout is not that repo), the hand-off still reads a carried PASS as unreadable ("holds no git reader"). That matches `--pr`. Run it from that repository's checkout.
- When the base commit is missing, the guard's fetch hint names the pull head and the old head but not the base. That text belongs to `record-recognisers.mjs`, so this PR leaves it alone.
- No changeset: `scripts/pm/**` publishes nothing from any released package, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Verification

Read first: the `pair` line in `handoffGate` (the risk hunk: `runGit` and `baseRef` added), `checkoutGit` / `handoffGitReader` above it, then the `R1` cases in the `--handoff` battery.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --self-test`. Expected output: `✓ label-write self-test: 407 cases pass across 19 batteries`.

<details><summary>Local gates at 4c0570e0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 64 commands. Each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe. 63 exited 0. `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no built `dist/` for the configs it lints; it does not read `scripts/pm`; left to CI). `dispatch-gates --ran`: `64 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`. Also: `overlap-check` VERDICT clean exit 0; `check-commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD` ✓.
</details>
